name: Grookey
notes: Painted design: one Body_dif shared by four materials (Body = flocky fur shader, Body2/Body3 = leaf and stick, Body_tail). Green fur on head (6), body (5) and legs (13) with clear short strokes; a pale yellow face patch on the head island; brown fur on ears (14), back of head (10) and tail (20); orange fur on arms (12, lower half), hands (18), feet (16) and fingers/toes (7, 8, 11); a glossy orange muzzle (23, 19); the head leaf (15, 9, 17) is painted with the same strokes plus a dark midrib; the stick (4) is a plain light-brown gradient; red mouth (22) and white tooth (21).

So: short fur along the painted strokes everywhere the artist painted fur (green, brown, orange), a little shorter and softer on the face patch; the muzzle (23, 19) is bare monkey skin: painted grain only, its gloss kept; the leaf stays a leaf: painted grain only, crisp midrib, a waxier _par; the stick, mouth and tooth are left alone (the artist painted no wood grain, so none is added).

Body (2701501019) samples a normal map but binds the dummy one, so a fur normal needs a material change; Body2/Body3 (2972460439) have no normal sampler. In game today: _dif and _par; Body_nor is cache-only.
